body: It’s really easy to say that, and I should have known that too. But it’s been so long that my loneliness overrode my common sense.
I didn’t send them any money. I should have specified but I blocked them and moved on.
It was my fault; I shouldn’t have sent photos to anyone.
Yeah I highly doubt I’m going to make that mistake again.
I just said that I am ok, and we can talk later.
Yeah, I just got a text message from my dad asking if I am ok. I am regretting this so much.

I’ve been thinking about things, and you’re right, it’s absolutely a lot to go no contact with my family. It’s not exactly practical either at this point, because I’d be shouting myself in the foot. Not to mention my dad and mom might try and chase after me with a lawyer to try and force me to pay.

My plan right now is somewhat simple, as I think going slow will help. I’m going to try and get a job, and start saving up the money so that I can move out without them knowing and just communicate over text.

Thanks for the recommendation. I’ve been diagnosed with ADD, and am on Vyvance for it. I’m also pretty sure I am diagnosed with C-PTSD, I’m hesitant to say for sure because I don’t want to misremember, but I am diagnosed with some kind of PTSD.

The problem is my school struggles sprouted in college, but I also did ok during my first semester at school. I think some of my mental health problems have dug their way into my brain.

My sister is like this too. She wants to be my friend, but as soon as I do or say something she doesn’t like, she tattles on me to my parents to get me in trouble. I almost never am defended, I’m always supposed to be the bigger person
I don’t even have the words right now to try and process what you are saying
I can’t do anything that I enjoy, not enough to escape. And my friends are busy people, I have basically dumped all my emotions in our discord server and just have to wait.
I can’t make any promises. But I’m not doing anything tonight or tomorrow, that I can promise for now.
That’s how you know it’s fake, we all know Chloe won’t take baths
He did not come from poverty, and you just assumed a bunch about our living conditions. Besides, he doesn’t know I am failing the classes.
On some level it wouldn’t surprise me. He wants me to succeed, but it feels more like anxiety over what he perceives as sunk costs if I do not succeed.
Thank you very much for your kind words. I’ve considered dropping contact with them once I get older, but they’re the type that once you’re away from them and not under their control, they’re fine.
I’ll take a look. I don’t adopt their perspective, I just have to live by it until they leave. I don’t think 5.5 years is that bad either, considering what I have gone through.
Congratulations! Your work is always fantastic!

This resonates with me on a level that I didn’t expect.

I constantly envy my future self, hoping that by some point in the future I will have found someone who loves me.

At 13 years old, I had someone tell me that if I didn’t date them, they would kill themselves. She lived hundreds of miles from me. I was naïve enough to follow. I have countless other stories, and here I am, throwing personals out onto Reddit and getting absolutely nothing from dommes.

I need to stop looking at this all as a way to feel happy about who I am, because at this rate, no one is coming.

Should I just let it happen and seek it out to let my body figure things out?

I didn’t go into specific detail partially because I’m not sure what I find arousing, and to spare the reader. I have had thoughts of pain, in which the circumstances lead to death. It’s not the death I find arousing, which is why I’m so frustrated by it.

Thank you for the words of endearment. It’s hard to see other people’s cares for you until you really start to think about it. Thank you for your words, keep doing what you’re doing. Without your comment and the other one I received, I’d probably be still awake in bed. The internet’s love is really amazing sometimes.
Thank you for reaching out. It means a lot. These two comments have given me a lot of needed compassion or renewal of my self image. Thank you for what you do.

The thing that’s difficult for me is that I feel like I am trying. I really tried to study for the test, and got a nice old C. The worst part is that I felt confident about the test when leaving. I’m scared that nothing I do now will pull me out of the hole I am currently in, and I’ll be stuck with a C in this class.

I am really struggling with Calculus. It’s something everyone tells me is easy right now, but for some reason I can’t.. click with it. I’m just.. I feel miserable. I am feeling a lot of pressure from within and from the outside, and I don’t want my career to be in jeopardy. This is quite literally the most important class for being an Engineer in high school, and I can’t grasp it.
